body: MAINLINE-008b filed: the 008 material gap table updated with every filed card; 25/25 checks reproduce the sealed rows they extend. (1) P2-E buckling SF now stated at kd 0.1407/0.20/0.90 for all 15 candidates; at 0.20 SiC 1.212, CNT 1.178, Be 1.501 and K13D2U 1.100 pass buckling; at the conservative 0.1407 none do (best SiC 0.853). (2) P1 stays buckling-dead for every candidate (best CNT 8.4e-3 of required E/rho^2); P3 stays Euler-dead (best Be 0.213). (3) On 007's light-core rows the face modes clear at 0.20: 1 kg/m3 row SiC 3.82, CNT 3.71, graphene 2.89 - but no catalog core exists at 1-4 kg/m3, so those rows are PROJECTION on the core side. (4) Wrinkling now binds on P2-E for every leading face: the best catalog core product misses 2.1x (CNT) to 9.9x (SiC); aluminium 39x. (5) Best three overall at 0.20: P2-E CNT-yarn 0.783, graphene 0.688, M55J 0.607, all wrinkling-limited; 1 kg/m3 row CNT 1.484, graphene 1.304, M55J 1.151. Available today: M55J, beryllium (yield-limited, 1.72x specific strength), K13D2U. The material gap has moved from face buckling to the core: its wrinkling product, and its existence at 1-4 kg/m3. Six NFI rows. Files pinned.
